newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain's share index rises 8.81 points.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain's share index rises 8.81 points.

text.p: Bahrain's share index climbed 8.81 points in the week on renewed investor interest in bank shares, the Bahrain Stock Exchange (BSE) said on Thursday.
The index ended at 1,547.91 points, up from 1,539.10 points a week earlier, it added.
Trading volume rose to 9.4 million shares worth 3.1 million dinars ($8.2 million) from eight million shares worth 2.57 million dinars.
Shares of 23 out of 39 firms registered at the bourse were traded in 235 transactions.
Investcorp continued to lead share trading for the second week with 2.2 million shares worth 1.59 million dinars ($4.2 million) changing hands. This accounted for 51 percent of total trading value.

Securities & Investment Research Co this week forecast that the international investment bank, Investcorp, would lift its 1996 net profit 50 percent to a record $110 million and pay a higher dividend.
Al-Ahli Commercial Bank shares followed Investcorp with 1.38 million shares worth 416,242 dinars changing hands.
Bahrain's bourse is open to nationals in Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain and the United Arab Emirates. Some firms are also open to foreign investors.
